label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcoma is explicitly eligible in a restricted salvage setting after clinical benefit and subsequent progression following ACT using TCR-T.
cohort_reconciliation: This single N-803 arm does not administer a new TCR-T therapy. Prior assessable TCR-T product, at least one scan showing SD/PR/CR and later progression are required, alongside feasible leukapheresis and clinical criteria.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No new explicit HLA or antigen assay threshold is stated; the required prior TCR-T treatment and product assessability cannot be inferred from SS histology.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and leukapheresis/product-assessment appendices are unreviewed. Age 18–80 and prior-treatment exclusions remain relevant. Saved recruitment does not establish live slots. Brief-summary mechanistic wording is not endorsed and no N-803 benefit is established.
quotes: Patients must have histologically or cytologically confirmed Synovial Sarcoma (SS) and/or Myxoid/Round Cell Liposarcoma (MRCL) who have progressed after ACT using TCR-T.
Patients must have shown clinical benefit on at least one scan post ACT using TCR-T, (SD, PR, CR), as determined by the treating investigator.
Patients must have been treated with a TCR-T product that can be assessed per medical history and/or discretion of the principal investigator.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: The master protocol explicitly names synovial sarcoma in its SS ISA treatment arms, although the master eligibility text is generic.
cohort_reconciliation: SS ISA has ramucirumab/gemcitabine/docetaxel and gemcitabine/docetaxel arms, distinct from DSRCT and ES ISAs. The experimental arm description omits docetaxel while its label and intervention mapping include it; this discrepancy is preserved.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Master criteria do not establish all SS ISA biomarker requirements; additional ISA criteria are explicitly deferred to individual addenda.
protocol_uncertainty: External ISA addenda are unreviewed; master ages 1–39, status and aggregate enrollment do not prove every ISA's age limits or live availability. Linked expanded-access marketing status does not establish SS approval or access.
quotes: Ramucirumab and gemcitabine given IV in 21-day cycles for synovial sarcoma (SS) ISA.
Gemcitabine and docetaxel given IV in 21-day cycles for SS ISA.
Additional criteria are specified in the protocol amendment (individual addenda) to which the participant will enroll.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Synovial sarcoma is expressly included among eligible HIFU-targetable STS histologies and is not a listed excluded histology.
cohort_reconciliation: Three STS pathways distinguish small resectable, in-field recurrent resectable, and unresectable/no-further-chemo-or-radiotherapy disease; the fourth pathway is for desmoids. HIFU targetability and size/site constraints apply separately from histology.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No molecular entry gate is stated. Optional research biopsies and immune measurements are not required positive biomarker results.
protocol_uncertainty: Anatomical exclusions, skin/imaging constraints, UK attendance, age at least 18 and treatment washouts remain. Source includes sacral chordoma while excluding chordoma and includes retroperitoneal sarcoma while excluding impractical retroperitoneal targeting; these conflicts do not erase the explicit SS route. Narrative 12–16 versus design enrollment 10 is unresolved. External protocol/live slots and source claims of safety or efficacy are not validated here.

All participants receive HIFU to their target tumour, hence this is a single arm study with 4 recruitment pathways.
